games.title: Red Team Dangling Tag
games.goal: Fixture: evidence tag that resolves to nothing in the citation table
script: Hand one block to the bear.
Say thank you for the bear.
games.level_up: Ask for two once, playfully, then return to one.
games.level_down: Keep the rhythm and drop the words for a while.
games.bilingual_note: Either home language works for this game.
